spans.s:
m. (-सः)
1 A goose, a gander, a swan.
2 BRAHMA, the supreme soul.
3 VIṢṆ

The sun.
5 A liberal or moderate prince, one not covetous nor ambitious.
6 A sort of ascetic or devotee.
7 A particular Mantra, or mystical or magical prayer.
8 A horse.
9 One of the vital airs.
10 Envy, malice.
11 Ś

IVA.
12

(In composition,) Best, excellent.
13 Preceding, before, in front.
14 A spiritual preceptor.
15 A mountain.
16 A buffalo.
17 KĀMA.
f. (-सी)
A goose.
E.
हन् to hurt or kill, Uṇādi aff. स.

m. (-कः)
1 An ornament for the feet, described as being made like a goose's foot.
2 The flamingo.
E.
कन् added to the last.

m. (-टः)
The hump on the shoulder of the Indian ox.
E.
हंस a goose, and कूट a peak.

f. (-दा)
A woman speaking sweetly or pleasantly.
E.
हंस a goose, गद to sound, reiterated, aff. अच् and टाप्.

f. (-नी)
A graceful woman.
E.
हंस a goose, (or swan,) and गामिनी who goes, (like.)

n. (-नं)
Agallochum.
E.
हंस a goose, and दाहन burning, exciting.

m. (-दः)
Cackling, the cry or noise of a goose.
E.
हंस, and नाद sound.

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
Cackling, making a noise like a goose.
f. (-नी)
An elegant woman, one of slender waist and large posteriors, with the gait of an elephant and voice of a Koïl.
E.
हंस a goose, नाद cry, इनि and ङीष् affs.

f. (-दी)
1 A scandent shrub, (Cissus pedata.)
2 Another plant, perhaps Clitoria ternata.
E.
हंस a goose, and पद foot; from a fancied resemblance between it and the flower; also हंसपादी.

n. (-दं)
Vermilion.
f. (-दी)
A shrub, (Clitoria ternata ?)
E.
हंस a goose, पाद a foot, (to which they are compared in colour, form, &c.): see the last; also in the fem. form, कन् added, हंसपादिका.

f. (-ला)
1 A duck.
2 A flight or flock of wild geese.
E.
हंस a goose, माला a garland or wreath.

m. (-थः)
BRAHMĀ.
E.
हंस a goose, and रथ vehicle.

n. (-शं)
Sulphate of iron.

f. (-ती)
A creeper, (Cissus pedata.)
E.
हंस a goose, (its foot,) and मतुप् aff.

m. (-नः)
BRAHMĀ.
E.
हंस a goose, and वाहन A vehicle.

m. (-ङ्घ्रिः)
Vermilion.
E.
हंस a goose, and अङ्घ्रि the foot.

n. (-ख्यं)
Silver.
E.
हंस a goose, अभिख्या beauty; being of similar colour.

f. (-का)
A goose.
E.
हंसी the same, and कन् added, or हन to kill, सिकन् Uṇādi aff.

ind.
1 An interjection of calling, (ho, holla!).
2 A particle of haughtiness or arrogance.
3 An arrogantly interrogative particle.
E.
हं and हो, both vocative particles.

r. 2nd cl. (हन्ति pl. घ्नन्ति)
1 To hurt, to strike, to injure, to do any act which tends to the destruction of life, to kill.
2 To go, to move.
3 To put an end to in any manner.
With अभि,
To sound a musical instrument.
With आङ्,
To smite.
With नि or परि,
To destroy, entirely.
With प्र,
1 To strike.
2 To place upon.
With प्रति,
To refute or destroy, an opposite argument.
With वि and आङ्,
To obstruct, to prevent, to hinder.
With सम्,
To slaughter:
(घन् or ध्न is substituted for the radical letters of this verb in many of its inflections and derivatives; the root also takes most of the prefixes with little or no variation of the sense.)

m. (-नः)
A killer, a slayer.
E.
हन to kill, अच् aff.; also with क्विप्, aff. हन् m. (-हा).

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Passed as ordure.
E.
हद to void fæces, aff. क्त.

n. (-नं)
1 Abandoning, relinquishing.
2 Prowess, valour.
E.
हा to leave, ल्युट् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Killing, destroying.
2 Injuring, hurting, striking.
3 (In arithmetic,) Multiplication.
E.
हन् to hurt or kill, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
What may be or ought to be struck, beaten, killed.
E.
हन to kill, अनीयर् aff.

mfn. (-नुः-नुः or नूः)
The jaw.
f. (-नुः)
1 A drug and perfume: see हट्टविलासिनी.
2 A weapon.
3

Sickness.
4

Death, dying.
E.
हन् to hurt or kill, aff. उ.

m. (-हः)
Locked jaw.
E.
हनु, and ग्रह seizure.

m. (-मान्)
1 The monkey chief HANUMĀN, the son of AÑJANĪ, by PAVANA, or the wind, the friend, ally and spy of RĀMACANDRA, in his invasion of Laṅkā.
2 A particular sort of monkey, (Simia sinica.)
E.
हनु the jaw, and मतुप् aff.; also with हनू the same, हनूमत् m. (-मान्.)

m. (-म्भः)
Locked jaw.
E.
हनु, and स्तम्भ stiffness.

m. (-षः)
A goblin, a demon.
E.
हन to kill, ऊषन् Uṇādi aff.

ind.
1 An inceptive particle.
2 An exclamation of grief, (ah, alas!)
3 Of pity.
4 Of pleasure.
5 Of hurry or haste.
E.
हन् to kill, त aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
What may be, or ought to be struck, killed, &c.
E.
हन, and तव्य aff.

m. (-रः)
Rice to be given to a guest.
E.
हन्ता a measure of food, and कार making.

Death.
2

A bull.
E.
हन to kill, तु aff.

m. (-न्ता)
1 A murderer, a slayer.
2 A measure of food, four times four double handfuls.
E.
हन to kill, तृच् Uṇādi aff.

f. (-क्तिः)
Tenderness, compassion.
E.
हन्त alas! and उक्ति saying.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Being killed or struck.
E.
हन to hurt or kill, pass. v., शानच् aff.

f. (-निः)
Loss, privation, abandonment, relinquishment.
E.
हा to leave, Uṇādi aff. नि.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Mischievous, hurting, killing.
E.
हन to hurt or kill, उकञ् aff.

n. (-न्द्रं)
Death, dying.
E.
हन to kill, ष्ट्रन् Uṇādi aff.
